method: Inverse of the two C2-only source edits, followed by TypeScript 5.9.3 compilation with the project tsconfig compiler options. Both output hashes match the previously recorded candidate.json hashes exactly.
limitations: Only source/build of server.ts were recovered here; dependency, skill and harness versions must also match their experiment evidence.
The snapshots must be placed in src/server.ts and dist/server.js in an isolated checkout before runtime use; load_skill resolves its catalog relative to that runtime location.
